title: Fixed Low Front-Bay Cargo Bicycle
description: One newly authored complete fixed long-wheelbase front-bay cargo bicycle. The rear rider triangle, saddle, crank and handlebar station are separated from the smaller front wheel and its whole fork by a true low open thick-floor cargo bay. Two complete low longitudinal frame members carry that bay and join the remote head structure. A full exterior fixed steering-link appearance connects the control-station arm to the front-fork arm. Both annular tires, rims, spoke sets, hubs, axles, pedals and a deployed two-foot stand belong to this one whole vehicle. No old bicycle vertices imported, no boxes hung onto the old city bike, no cargo quantity variants. One static prop, zero scenes; no riding, steering, braking, drive, load, human fit or safe transportation claim.
